algorithms.failure_condition: Resolve and validate the full core object against the retained closed core schema; empty or partially shaped deterministic content fails.
Fail unless the full core validates, all extension roles occur exactly once in fixed order and path, and no extension path duplicates any core contract path.
Fail unless algorithms and negative fixture IDs equal the exact schema-frozen arrays byte-for-semantic-value.

For BOOTSTRAP require the policy path absent at canonical base; for REBASE require predecessor blob and digest equal the canonical-base file. Any changed policy must be policy-only and cannot carry dependent evidence in the same candidate.
Fail on wrong order, duplicate semantic key, duplicate id, duplicate path, or ambiguous normalization.
Fail unless all six categories have matcher, critical-surface, and live Git-blob witness coverage; matcher/surface/witness IDs are unique and every reference resolves.
Fail unless scenario_id, assertion_id and fixture path are individually unique and scenario/assertion membership is exactly one-to-one across all artifacts.
Fail unless every path resolves to exactly one recorded regular-file blob and every eligible tracked source appears once.
Fail on missing, unknown, duplicate, overlapping, or arithmetically inconsistent production or critical-surface coverage, or policy lineage mismatch.
Fail unless every listed in-target mutant has exactly one required or precanonical excluded disposition and result membership equals required membership.
Fail unless each waiver resolves uniquely, binds the same mutant/path/class, and was canonical before the candidate.
Fail unless the three keyed contexts are unique, exact-head, successful, app-bound, workflow/job-bound and canonical-base workflow-blob-bound.
Parse context-prefixed GitHub refs, require three distinct numeric IDs within each ID domain, and bind every API result to the single top-level head_sha/base_sha.
Construct all API locations from owner/name/ref/path/id fields; supplied URLs are absent and therefore never authority.
Fail unless event=pull_request, workflow_id=335093310, run_attempt=1, check_suite_id=86559814682, pull_requests contains PR 11, and run/artifact/head/base identities all agree.
Fail unless every required role appears exactly once, all paths are globally unique, and Git blob plus raw SHA-256 match source bytes.
Fail on non-portable path, traversal, symlink component, wrong owner/link count, or containment escape.
Fail on overflow, negative values, prohibited zero denominators, or any count/equality mismatch.
Fail unless policy digests, lineage, schema ids, target sets, limits, exclusions, commands and inventory source identities agree exactly.

Enforce exact per-inventory semantic keys: unique source path; unique assertion_id and scenario_id; unique replay assertion/scenario; unique coverage path and surface_id; unique mutant_id and exact result membership; unique corpus scenario/assertion/path; unique enforcement role/path.
Apply byte/file/record/depth limits before semantic parsing; any limit violation fails with a classified reject or parent-enforced kill.

Fail unless a dedicated unprivileged verifier subprocess is identified by binary SHA and lock blob, parent wall timeout and cgroup memory/PID limits are active, network is none, root is read-only, stdout/stderr observed byte counts and exceeded flags satisfy the policy ceilings exactly with neither stream exceeded, and termination is one allowed class.

Fail unless the inventory equals the exact schema-frozen role set with unique roles; reject unknown or duplicate roles. For every role whose required_from_stack is at or before the current stack, planned_path and entrypoint must resolve to the canonical-base implementation/schema/workflow authority; future-stack unresolved paths remain non-green only when their activation stack begins.
Fail unless independently canonicalized deterministic envelope hashes exactly to outer af02_adversarial_sha256; stochastic observations never affect this digest.
